_comment: Baseline .claude/settings.json for Lead Intake Triage Agent, scaffolded by prompts/04 on 2026-09-04. See docs/claude-directory-spec.md and docs/token-discipline.md §7 for what each section is for.

permissions._comment: Pre-approve safe, read-only, high-frequency operations so they stop triggering permission prompts. Extend this list from actual usage rather than guessing — see the fewer-permission-prompts skill.

mcpServers._comment: See .claude/mcp-servers.md for which servers (if any) this project actually uses and why. Empty by default — most portfolio projects need none. Enable only what's actively integrated; each enabled server adds overhead to every prompt.

modelRouting._comment: See .claude/model-strategy.md for the full rationale. Keys are illustrative skill/command names — adjust to what this project actually has.

hooks._comment: Post-change validation loop (docs/plan-execute-review.md §Execute Phase). Wire an actual hook here only if this project's tooling supports one non-noisily; otherwise apply the loop as a manual discipline within Step 6's prompt and skip this section. Do not add a hook that fires on every tool call without producing actionable output (see docs/token-discipline.md §7).
